description: This Java source file defines the abstract class LifeCycle, which manages the lifecycle of a mock server, including starting, stopping, and port binding, using Netty framework components and custom mock server configurations.

classes.name: LifeCycle
classes.description: An abstract class managing the lifecycle of a mock server, including startup, shutdown, port binding, and listener registration, utilizing Netty event loops and custom configurations.

methods.name: stopAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously stops the server, disconnects channels, stops HTTP state and scheduler, and shuts down event loops.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the server synchronously, waiting up to 10 seconds for shutdown.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the server by invoking stop().

methods.name: getEventLoopGroup
methods.description: Returns the worker EventLoopGroup used by the server.

methods.name: getScheduler
methods.description: Returns the scheduler instance managing scheduled tasks.

methods.name: isRunning
methods.description: Checks if the server's boss or worker event loops are active.

methods.name: getLocalPorts
methods.description: Retrieves list of ports the server is bound to.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Deprecated method to get the first bound port.

methods.name: getLocalPort
methods.description: Returns the first port the server is bound to.

methods.name: bindServerPorts
methods.description: Binds the server to requested ports and returns the actual bound ports.

methods.name: registerListener
methods.description: Registers an ExpectationsListener to be notified of expectation updates.
